name: User Media
description: Get live media from the user using a camera or microphone device.

conditions.description: Triggered after the user approves the prompt from a media request.
Triggered on an error, or if the user declines the prompt from a media request.
Triggered after 'Get media sources' when the media source list is available.
Triggered after the 'Snapshot' action when the snapshot URL is ready.

actions.display-text: Request camera source [i]{0}[/i] (prefer [i]{1}[/i] at {2} x {3}, include mic [i]{4}[/i] source [i]{5}[/i])
actions.description: Prompt the user for access to video input from a camera, if one is present.

source.name: Source
source.desc: The zero-based index of the camera source to use.

preferred-direction.name: Preferred direction
preferred-direction.desc: The preferred camera facing mode, if multiple cameras are present. Commonly mobile devices have both user-facing (front) and environment-facing (back) cameras.

preferred-width.name: Preferred width
preferred-width.desc: The preferred horizontal resolution. Leave at 0 for default.

preferred-height.name: Preferred height
preferred-height.desc: The preferred vertical resolution. Leave at 0 for default.

include-mic.name: Include microphone
include-mic.desc: Whether to also request audio input from the user's microphone. Useful to allow recording combined video and audio.

mic-source.name: Microphone source
mic-source.desc: The zero-based index of the audio source to use, if microphone is included.

actions.description: Take a snapshot of the current image from the camera.  Use 'SnapshotURL' expression to get result.

format.name: Format
format.desc: Choose the file format to save the snapshot.  PNG is lossless but JPEG files are smaller.

jpeg-quality.name: JPEG quality
jpeg-quality.desc: If 'Format' is 'JPEG', the JPEG quality from 0 (worst) to 100 (best).  Ignored for PNG.

actions.display-text: Request microphone source [i]{1}[/i] and route to Audio tag {0}
actions.description: Prompt the user for access to audio input from a microphone, if one is present. The Audio object must be added to the project.

tag.name: Tag
tag.desc: A tag in the Audio object to route the microphone input to.

source.name: Source
source.desc: The zero-based index of the audio source to use.

actions.description: Request a list of the available media sources. 'On retrieved media sources' will trigger shortly after.

expressions.description: Return the width of the image from the device camera.
Return the height of the image from the device camera.
Return a data URI containing image data from a snapshot. Can be set to a Sprite or Tiled Background.
Return the number of audio sources available.
Return the label of a given audio source.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of the audio source.

expressions.description: Return the number of camera sources available.
Return the label of a given camera source.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of the camera source.

expressions.description: Return the facing (e.g. front/back) of a given camera source.

index.name: Index
index.desc: Zero-based index of the camera source.
